name: week
title: This week in email
subtitle: What needs a person, what goes out next and what is due from the flows

sections.title: Needs attention
sections.sql: select issue, ref, "when", detail from v_attention order by issue, ref

sections.title: Going out next
sections.sql: select campaign, status, to_char(scheduled_for,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as scheduled, segment, approved_by, subject from v_calendar where status in ('draft','approved') order by scheduled_for nulls last

sections.title: Flow emails due now
sections.sql: select flow, step_no as step, count(*) as people, to_char(min(due_at),'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as oldest_due from v_flows_due group by flow, step_no order by flow, step_no

name: results
title: What email earned
subtitle: Campaign results, flows and the share of store revenue that came from email

sections.title: Campaigns
sections.sql: select campaign, to_char(sent_at,'YYYY-MM-DD') as sent_on, sent, open_pct, click_pct, complained, orders, revenue_cents, currency from v_campaign_results order by sent_at desc

sections.title: Flows, last 30 days
sections.sql: select flow, active, sent_30d, clicked_30d, orders_30d, revenue_30d_cents, currency from v_flow_health order by revenue_30d_cents desc

sections.title: Store revenue and email's share, by month
sections.sql: with s as (select store_currency from v_setting), m as (select generate_series(date_trunc('month', now()) - interval '5 months', date_trunc('month', now()), interval '1 month') as month) select to_char(m.month,'YYYY-MM') as month, (select coalesce(sum(total_cents),0) from orders o where not refunded and currency = s.store_currency and date_trunc('month', placed_at) = m.month) as store_cents, (select coalesce(sum(total_cents),0) from v_attribution a where a.currency = s.store_currency and date_trunc('month', placed_at) = m.month) as from_email_cents, s.store_currency as currency from m cross join s order by m.month

name: list
title: List health
subtitle: Who you can email, who has gone quiet, and the customer value bands

sections.title: Customer bands
sections.sql: select band, count(*) as people, count(*) filter (where consent = 'subscribed') as subscribed, sum(spend_cents) as spend_cents, max(currency) as currency from v_rfm group by band order by sum(spend_cents) desc

sections.title: Sunset candidates
sections.sql: select email, first_name, to_char(last_engaged_at,'YYYY-MM-DD') as last_engaged, orders from v_customer where consent = 'subscribed' and last_engaged_at < now() - make_interval(days => (select unengaged_days from v_setting)) order by last_engaged_at

sections.title: Consent and unsubscribe findings
sections.sql: select rule, ref, finding from v_compliance order by rule, ref
